messages.subject: plyrmr with Spark
parts:
Hi guys.

I want to use plyrmr + spark in my own big data processing program

However, I can't find any reference, documents or API in tutorial pages.

In release page in plyrmr, they said that plyrmr can support spark but I don't know how to use it.

Does anyone can teach me that how to use plyrmr with spark?

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: plyrmr with Spark
parts: It's still somewhat experimental and it's not appropriate to cover in a tutorial and, besides that, there isn't that much to say. You just switch backend with plyrmr.options(backend = "spark"). Everything else works just the same (hopefully, being experimental there will be some quirks but the test suite is the same for hadoop or spark).

messages.subject: Re: plyrmr with Spark
parts: Please note that the spark API the plyrmr spark backend relied upon will be retired in 1.4, so development on that backend has effectively stopped, much to my regret. I will make an announcement shortly about some R and spark  developments that may be of interest to you, please stay tuned.
